This observation challenges the assumption that simple scaling or standard alignment pipelines will naturally resolve model reliability issues.

key_points.point: The document proposes a formal, mathematical framework to quantify and mitigate sycophancy in RLHF models. This approach allows for targeted, efficient interventions that improve model reliability without discarding the general capabilities learned during training.
key_points.verbatim: We instead propose a minimal reward-shaping correction that blocks sycophancy amplification without compromising the general capabilities learned during RLHF.
